reason: 23 tools: the 15 collapsed tools + 7 preserved M2 semantic editing tools (nomi_canvas_plan retired 2026-09-05 — it was byte-identical to nomi_canvas_edit in tools/list, a P1 parallel version on the public surface). Recalibrated upward once (20016 -> 24052) when canvas.write and timeline.write stopped broadcasting a hand-written flat superset and started deriving their transport schema from the Zod validator: that is what makes all 9 canvas operations and timeline preview/apply constructible at all (7 of them were structurally unreachable before), and it carries the prompt-writing guidance and reference-slot semantics to the host. The added bytes are the fields and guidance a host previously had to guess. Ratchet stays only-decrease from here; see docs/fixes/2026-09-05-mcp-host-holes.root-cause.json.
